title: BDE (Business Development Executive)noi
description:
Job description:

**Date posted:** 21-October- 2026

**Pay:** ₹15,000.00-₹25,000.00 per month

**Job Description:**

About Sky Education Group

Sky Education Group is an education counselling and enrollment partner working with 28+ universities across India. We help students and working professionals choose the right Online & Distance UG and PG programmes based on their academic background, career goals and requirements.

We are looking for a Business Development Executive who has already worked/willing to start their career in the Online/Distance Higher Education / EdTech admission sales domain and can start handling leads with minimal training.

Fresher/Experience both can apply for this role.

We are specifically looking for candidates who already understand:

* Online & Distance Education
* UG & PG admission counselling
* University/course comparison
* B2C lead handling
* Telephonic counselling
* Follow-up and objection handling
* Admission conversion
* CRM/lead management
* Closing the admission cycle

Key Responsibilities

* Handle **fresh and existing leads** through telephone calls, WhatsApp and other communication channels.
* Understand the student's **education, career goals, work experience and course requirements**.
* Counsel students for Online & Distance UG/PG programmes such as:
* **BBA**
* **BCA**
* **B.Com**
* **MBA**
* **MCA**
* Other relevant UG/PG programmes
* Explain and compare universities, programmes, eligibility, fees, admission process and other relevant details.
* Counsel students regarding programmes offered through leading universities such as **NMIMS, LPU, Amity, Chandigarh University, Manipal University** and other partner universities.
* Handle student objections related to **fees, university selection, course validity, programme structure, placements, admission process and competitors**.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with interested prospects and move them towards admission.
* Coordinate with the admission/operations team until the student's admission process is successfully completed.
* Maintain accurate lead and follow-up information in the CRM.
* Achieve **monthly admission and revenue targets**.
* Maintain high-quality counselling while focusing strongly on **conversion and closures**.

What We Are Looking For Mandatory :

* **6months-1 year of relevant experience** in Online Education / Distance Education / EdTech admission sales will be preferred .
* Have experience selling **Online/Distance UG & PG programmes will be beneficial** .
* Candidates who have previously worked with **Online University, EdTech, University Enrollment Partner, Education Consultancy or similar organizations** are preferred.
* Strong understanding of the **Online Education admission process**.
* Proven experience in **B2C telephonic counselling and sales conversion but not mandatory**.
* Comfortable handling a high volume of calls and follow-ups.
* Strong communication skills in **Hindi & English**.
* Strong convincing, negotiation and objection-handling ability.
* Comfortable working with sales targets.
* Candidate should be able to **start handling leads with minimal training**.

Who Will Be a Strong Fit?

Someone who has previously worked as:

* Business Development Executive
* Career Counsellor – EdTech
* Inside Sales Executive – EdTech
* Online Education Counsellor
* University Admission Counsellor

and has actually converted Online/Distance Education leads into admissions.

Interview

Face-to-Face Interview / Walk-in

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

title: Senior Officer - Customer Operations
description:
**Designation:** Key Accounts Officer / Executive
  
  
**Reporting to:** Area Sales Manager
  
  
**Location:** Chandigarh
  
  
**Role:** To manage the modern trade outlets like Big Bazaar, Dmart etc. and achieve the required sales
  
target for the respective territory along with ensuring availability and visibility of Nestlé products in the
  
outlets.
  
  
**Job Description:**  
1. Planning Customer Plan
  
Planning an Integrated Commercial Plan for assigned customer
  
Develop rolling monthly sales plan at Customer/Account level for the following 3 months
  
Assortment Planning at Customer/Account level
  
Develop Account specific Activation Calendar on a Quarterly Basis
  
2. Customer Management
  
Achieving Volume Planned during OPL
  
Planning & Execution of Account Specific Activation Programs
  
Account Specific Customer Service
  
Price Control & Stability, Act as a single window
  
Terms of Trade Agreement & Implementation
  
3. Progress Review & Suggest Inputs to Generate Demand
  
Achievement & monitor progress of Redistribution value and volume targets
  
Present Account wise review on a Quarterly basis
  
Identify Gaps at customer level vis-à-vis Business Plans & suggest inputs
  
Ensure Nestle contribution to Account perpetually increases over time. Monitor, evaluate & Control CCS
  
  
**Key Skills:**  

* Communication Skills
* Analytical Approach
* Networking Skills
* Flexible and Resourceful
* Innovativeness
* Poise & Confidence
* Understanding of sales systems and processes.

title: Inside Sales Executive
description:
Position: Business Development Executive

Location: Mohali

Experience: 1-2 Years

Industry: Digital Marketing / Digital Services

Employment Type: Full-Time

Key Responsibilities

Generate and convert leads into clients for digital marketing and digital services.

Handle inbound and outbound leads through calls, email, LinkedIn, and other channels.

Understand client requirements and recommend suitable digital solutions.

Sell services such as SEO, PPC, Social Media Marketing, Graphic Design, and Video/Creative Services.

Manage the complete sales cycle from lead generation → follow-up → proposal → negotiation → closure.

Conduct client meetings, presentations, and online demos.

Consistently follow up with prospects and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.

Achieve monthly and quarterly sales and conversion targets.

Negotiate pricing and close deals effectively.

Maintain client and lead information in CRM.

Coordinate with the digital/technical team for smooth project handover.

Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling digital services.

Requirements

2–5 years of experience in Digital Sales / Business Development / IT Sales.

Proven experience in converting digital service leads and closing deals.

Strong knowledge of digital marketing and web services.

Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

Target-oriented with a strong closing and conversion mindset.

Experience dealing with international clients will be an advantage.

Comfortable with cold calling, follow-ups, LinkedIn, email outreach, and virtual meetings.

KPIs

Lead-to-client conversion rate

Monthly revenue

Deals closed

New client acquisition

Sales target achievement

Follow-up and pipeline management

Upselling/cross-selling revenue

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Are you okay with relocating to mohali, chandigarh for this job?
* This is a night shift from 9pm to 4am, are you comfortable for that?
* How many years of experience you have in digital services?
* How many years of exp you have in Business Development ?
* have you worked with foreign clients?
* What is your current CTC?

title: Business Executive - Mohali
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
Position Summary
  
You will connect with healthcare professionals across Mohali, building trust through clear, science-based information that supports better patient care. You will create and deliver a territory plan that reflects local needs and customer insights. Working closely with colleagues across teams, you will help solve challenges and improve patient access. We seek curious, honest, and practical thinkers who want to learn and grow. This role offers strong learning opportunities, meaningful career growth, and a chance to unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.  
  
Responsibilities
  
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  

* Build and maintain respectful, professional relationships with doctors, pharmacists, and other healthcare partners across your territory.
* Develop and execute a territory business plan based on customer insight and local patient needs.
* Share clear and accurate science-based information to support healthcare professionals’ decision-making.
* Record and report activities, outcomes, and customer insights accurately using company systems and tools.
* Collaborate with colleagues across functions to address customer needs and improve patient access.
* Continuously expand your knowledge of clinical evidence, market trends, and ways to enhance your performance.

  
Why You?  
  
Work type
  
This is an on-site role based in Mohali and requires regular travel within the assigned territory. You will be part of a supportive team that provides coaching and practical feedback. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage people with different perspectives to apply. We value inclusion and strive to create a workplace where everyone can contribute and grow.  
  
Basic Qualification
  
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:
  

* Bachelor’s degree from a recognised institution.
* Minimum 1 year of customer-facing experience in field sales, medical business, or territory management roles.
* Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel regularly within the territory.
* Good verbal and written communication skills in English and Punjabi or Hindi; knowledge of local languages is a plus.
* Basic digital skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Right to work in India.

  
Preferred Qualification
  
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:
  

* Prior experience in pharmaceutical, medical, or healthcare-related roles.
* Comfortable discussing clinical evidence and explaining scientific concepts to healthcare professionals.
* Strong planning, organisation, and time management skills.
* Ability to use customer insight and simple data to guide your activities and priorities.
* Fluency in Punjabi or other local languages spoken in Mohali.
* High motivation to learn, adapt, and take on increasing responsibility.

  
Ready to apply?
  
If this role fits your skills and ambitions, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and take the next step in your career while helping us unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.

**Job Location - Mohali**

**Skills**

Customer Centric Selling, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Omnichannel, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.
